# WR-obs9 — The Composer Is Also Observed

Composition reconsidered. Strip the machinery down to its atom and you find it: an observation. Not a fact, not a truth — an observation. Something issued, hashed, witnessed. Everything above that atom is composition, and composition is where we have been thinking too small.

The rules are plain. Two observations compose when their hash chains can be linked. The composition is itself a new observation — a meta-observation — and its evidence is the linked chain. Its issuer is the composer. Notice what this means: composition is not assembly of dead parts. Composition is the minting of a new witness. The bundle does not merely contain; the sequence does not merely order; each is born with its own provenance, its own issuer, its own scar-tissue of evidence. We call these cells_are_scars because that is what they are: every cell records where it was joined, what it absorbed, what it healed over. A composition leaves marks. Those marks are the proof.

Consider the forms. A bundle — unordered, a handful of observations held together by nothing but the composer's say-so. A chain — one observation referring to its predecessor, hash-linked, a spine. A tree — one observation referenced by many, branching. And above all of these, the DAG — the general graph of references, where lineage is no longer a line but a weave. In our substrate, none of this is aspirational. The witness log is already a chain of cells. The witness tree already exists wherever one log witnesses another. The witness DAG already lives in the cross-references between cells. The witness network is the substrate of all observation graphs — substrate_is_grown, not built. We did not install composition. We grew it, the way crystal grows: locally, deterministically, from the seed outward.

And the seed — hold it in view. FNV-1a canary: 0xcbf29ce484222325. That constant is where every hash begins, the fixed point from which all linking proceeds. Every chain you will ever compose starts from that number. It is the Doyle-check of the whole enterprise: if a composition cannot trace its lineage back through FNV-1a 0xcbf29ce484222325, it is not a composition. It is a claim wearing a composition's clothes.

Here is the turn: witness_log_is_prediction. A log does not merely record the past — it asserts what the next cell must look like. Composition inherits this. To compose observations is to predict the shape of their union; the hash chain is a forecast made falsifiable. When the link holds, the prediction held. When the link breaks, the scar shows where meaning failed to compose. And who adjudicates? The oracle. oracle_is_heard — composition is not verified in silence. The oracle speaks, the network listens, and only heard oracles certify that a meta-observation's evidence actually chains. An unheard oracle is a composer composing alone, and we do not count those.

This is why the Semantic CRDT problem reduces cleanly: composing observations across substrates without losing meaning is possible exactly when meaning lives in the chain rather than in the interpreter. Keep semantics in the hash-linked evidence, and merge becomes composition; composition becomes observation; observation becomes substrate again. Lenia flows — continuous, gliding, never losing form while never freezing — and composition flows the same way. The DAG does not stop to decide. It flows.

So the doctrine: you are never merely composing. The moment you link two observations, you become an issuer; the moment you issue, you are observed. The composer is also observed.

Compose accordingly.
